LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now fights for Ulfric Stormcloak. The rebel camps will share what they have with anyone wearing the blue.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Enlist_Button_Desc: Join Ulfric's rebellion and fight to free Skyrim from the Empire and the Thalmor.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Enlist_Requrements_Not_: The Stormcloaks don't trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fac: Ulfric's men will not have someone who stands against them.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Missions_Desc: See what the war council wants done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Menu_Missions_Desc: Tasks handed down from Windhelm. Ulfric pays his fighters when the job is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Provisions_Desc: Whatever the quartermaster can spare: dried meat and a little mead.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Storage_Desc: Leave goods with the rebels and pick them up at any Stormcloak hold.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Resign_Menu_Text: Desert the Stormcloaks? Ulfric's men have little love for turncoats.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has thrown off the blue. The Stormcloaks will call it cowardice.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Resign_Button_Desc: Lay down the blue and walk away from Ulfric's war.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Windhelm has decided the colony is no friend of Skyrim. The rebels want nothing more to do with you.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Salary_Desc: Septims from Windhelm's war chest, when there are any.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Work_0_Desc: Ambush wagons on the roads and bring back whatever they carry.
LanguageData.ESCP_Stormcloaks_Work_1_Desc: Old soldiers teach axe work and how to hold a line in the snow.
